name: Feature request

title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the use case or limitation you ran into.

Example: "I want to ... but currently RiserBob does not ..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature or change you would like to see. If it affects the public API, include a short code example of how you imagine using it.

```ts
// Example of the proposed API
```

## Alternatives Considered

Other solutions or workarounds you considered, and why they are not enough.

## Impact

- Which part of RiserBob does this affect? (routing, middleware, validation, responses, server, other)
- Would this change existing behavior or break backward compatibility?

## Additional Context

Anything else that might help: links, related issues, references to similar features in other frameworks, or mockups.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and this feature has not been requested.
- [ ] I described the problem, not only the solution.
- [ ] I understand that feature requests may be declined if they do not fit the project's goals.
- [ ] I have read the Code of Conduct.
